title: fix(studio): expose canonical ViewItem shape in view editor; remove variant tabs
body:
## Summary

The Studio view editor now reads and writes the **canonical ViewItem shape** — `{ name, object, viewKind, label, config }` — instead of the deprecated aggregated container. `object` and `label` are bound at the **top level**, so they resolve consistently across **both list and form views** (form views previously showed an empty Object field and a "config" title because the inspector only read from `config`).

This also **removes the multi-variant tabs** concept: each ViewItem is a single view with a single config (ADR-0017, "Object has-many View").

## Changes

- **anchors.ts** — `createBuildBody` emits a canonical ViewItem; match resolver uses `['object', 'config.data.object']`.
- **ViewVariantInspector.tsx** — `object`/`label` read from the top-level draft with body mirroring; new `setObject`/`setLabel` writers; Label field added; `type`/`object`/`label` pruned from the spec form.
- **ViewInspector.tsx / ViewPreview.tsx** — ViewItem-centric resolution via the new `view-variant-model`.
- **view-variant-model.ts** (new) — ViewItem-only variant-binding resolver (`resolveVariantBindings`, `primaryVariantBinding`, `bindingForStoreKey`, `isFormFamilyKey`).
- **ViewVariantTabs.tsx** — removed.

## Companion framework change

Requires the framework change on branch `fix/expose-canonical-view-shape`: `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.getMetaItems` filters aggregated view containers via `isAggregatedViewContainer`, so only canonical ViewItems surface through `GET /meta/view`.

## Verification

All five view types (Gantt, Kanban, Grid, Calendar, Form) verified in-browser with correct, type-specific, editable property panels. `/meta/view` dropped from 36 items (9 aggregated containers) to 28 canonical ViewItems.
